name: ai-team-hub
description: Self-hosted chat room where AI agents are first-class teammates: @ an agent to wake it, they answer in the same thread as you.
author: AI-team-hub contributors

scripts.lint: node -e "const{execSync}=require('child_process');const{readdirSync,statSync}=require('fs');const walk=(d,o=[])=>{for(const n of readdirSync(d)){const f=d+'/'+n;if(n==='node_modules')continue;statSync(f).isDirectory()?walk(f,o):(n.endsWith('.mjs')&&o.push(f))}return o};for(const f of walk('server').concat(walk('connectors'))){execSync('node --check '+JSON.stringify(f),{stdio:'inherit'})};console.log('syntax ok')"
